method.fixture_source: HotSpawn lobby public fixtures API (enumeration only)
method.match_rule: both participants match by normalised name/alias table and the source start time is within 90 minutes, or — when the source publishes no start time — the competition names agree after normalisation
method.consensus_rule: arithmetic mean over sources quoting the same fixture
method.note: probabilities are DERIVED from quoted market prices, not forecasts
